text.p: EchoStar DBS Corp's upcoming $325 million offering of five-year senior secured notes is expected to yield between 12.25 percent and 12.50 percent, according to a buyside source on Wednesday.
The 144A deal, managed via lead manager Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, is slated for formal pricing on Friday, market sources said.
EchoStar DBS Corp is a holding company formed by EchoStar Communications Corp.
The deal will be structured with a two-and-a-half year interest reserve.

Sources said EchoStar is seeking financing for additional satellites following the derailed $1.0 billion investment from News Corp. Under the terms of the initial plan, News Corp would have provided a $200 million loan for capital buildout.
The two companies are tangled in litigation.
EchoStar DBS Corp is a holding company formed by EchoStar Communications Corp. EchoStar would not comment on the deal.
